_source: OpenCity (data.opencity.in) PMC Prabhag Boundary dataset, KML export, as downloaded 2026-08-10 (dataset labeled as updated 2025)
_note: Real polygon boundaries per prabhag (with ward/ward_id/prabhag/prabhag_id/zone_id attributes), not just reference points. Used only to suggest a ward/prabhag by point-in-polygon containment; the ward_id/prabhag_id fields here are NOT assumed to equal PMC Care API IDs — the suggested ward/prabhag name is always re-matched against a live wards()/prabhags() call to get real IDs before use.
